main_text.l: QVI veram ac simplicem Christiana
Religionis doctrinam ex ipsis Apostolorum tempori-
bus reuocatam, ac repetitam, insolentia atque no-
vitatis insimulant, unde tandem hi Martyres
hodie prodeant, miraturos esse minime dubita-
mus: quum iidem, à multis iam annis huiusmodi
Athletarum amissa memoria, vel potius iam inter-
missa videri possit. Quibus ut respondeamus, sic ha-
beant: ut de illis ipsi nihil nec audiverint nec au-
dire profecto voluerint, non idcirco haud amissam
illorum, haud intermissam videri oportere me-
moriam. Nam ut istis demus, statis temporum
interuallis prostratam ac iacentem quodammodo fuis-
se Christi Ecclesiam; extinctam certe fuisse prorsus
sine scelere pronuntiare non possumus. Quod
quidem ex eo intelligi potest, quoniam alio tempore
plures, alio vero pauciores, nunquam certe nulli Mar-
tyres extiterunt: nimirum vlli qui sic Christiana
doctrina testes ac praecones extiterint, ut eam suo
sanguine obsignare non dubitarent. At vero
quum Ecclesiam ipsam aliquandiu iacentem in-
quam, & quodammodo sopitam Christus longè am-
pliorem & illustriorem, centum circiter, aut eo am-
plius, annis ipse renocarit, maiorem etiam qui pro
causa sua defensionem pugnarent numerum ex-
citauit. Nam, Vt penè extinctum cinerem si sul-
phure tangas, Viuet & ex minimo maximus ignis
erit. Itaque quum Christus suo sulphure, feruo-
re nempe Spiritus sui, Fidelium animos propè

page.notes: The printed text is Latin in italic type with long words and ligatures. Some letters in the scan are worn, especially at the line ends, but I was able to read the page. The "ii." at the bottom right is a signature mark and is given under bottom_margin. The running head is ADMONITIO. in capitals. The page has no page number printed at the head or foot. The text ends mid-sentence at "propè" and continues on the next page. The Latin contains the words "vlli", "iidem", and "testes" as printed; the printing is not corrected. The word "centum circiter" and the surrounding clause are read as printed. Some uncertain readings are marked nowhere because the scan is clear enough for them; minor doubts about "nunquam" (printed "nunquā" with a macron) are noted here.
